entry.name: mode
entry.label: Operating mode: "todo" (local task list), "jira" (Jira issues), "gh" (GitHub Projects) or "notion" (Notion pages via the ntn CLI).

entry.name: categoryCount
entry.label: Number of active categories (1..7)

entry.name: categoryNames
entry.label: Names for each category (up to 7)

entry.name: categoryColors
entry.label: Hex colors for each category (up to 7)

entry.name: showPriorityIcons
entry.label: Show priority badges on tasks

entry.name: priorityLevels
entry.label: Priority letters, from lowest to highest. Editable count and text.

entry.name: priorityColors
entry.label: Hex color for each priority letter (parallel to priorityLevels).

entry.name: confirmDelete
entry.label: Ask for confirmation before deleting archived tasks

entry.name: todoJiraLink
entry.label: Show a button on each ToDo task to link it to a Jira issue/subtask

entry.name: panelShowLabels
entry.label: Show category names next to counters in the panel

entry.name: panelShowZero
entry.label: Show categories with zero pending tasks in the panel

entry.name: panelCounterStyle
entry.label: Counter layout in the panel: "right" (number to the right of the swatch) or "inside" (number drawn inside the swatch)

entry.name: panelCounterColors
entry.label: Per-category counter text color: "white" or "black" (up to 7)

entry.name: panelCounterScale
entry.label: Scale (%) of the "inside" counter swatch: 100 = current size, down to 50 = half size (square, number and spacing all shrink).

entry.name: popupWidth
entry.label: Popup width in pixels

entry.name: popupHeight
entry.label: Popup height in pixels

entry.name: jiraSite
entry.label: Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net

entry.name: jiraEmail
entry.label: Jira account email (username for API token auth)

entry.name: jiraToken
entry.label: Jira API token (NOT your password). Create one at id.atlassian.com. Stored in plain text under ~/.config — see docs/JIRA.md.

entry.name: jiraJql
entry.label: JQL query for the issues to display
entry.default: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC

entry.name: jiraRefreshMinutes
entry.label: Auto-refresh interval in minutes (0 = manual only)

entry.name: jiraMaxResults
entry.label: Maximum number of issues to fetch per call

entry.name: jiraShowDone
entry.label: (legacy) Show the Done tab — superseded by jiraCategory* entries.

entry.name: jiraCategoryCount
entry.label: Number of Jira categories (tabs)

entry.name: jiraCategoryNames
entry.label: Display name of each Jira category (up to 10)

entry.name: jiraCategoryColors
entry.label: Hex color of each Jira category (up to 10)

entry.name: jiraCategoryTextColors
entry.label: "white" or "black" text color for each Jira category swatch (up to 10)

entry.name: jiraCategoryFilterFields
entry.label: Field that each Jira category filters on (up to 10). Default: status (exact status name).

entry.name: jiraCategoryFilterValues
entry.label: Value to match for each Jira category (use ';' for OR, up to 10)

entry.name: jiraStatusNames
entry.label: Status names whose chip color is overridden

entry.name: jiraStatusColors
entry.label: Hex color for each overridden status name

entry.name: jiraSprintField
entry.label: Custom field id that holds the Sprint on your issues (used for the sprint progress bar). Usually customfield_10020.

entry.name: jiraRemainingMode
entry.label: How the sprint "Disponible" hours are computed: "calculated" = max(0, original - spent); "api" = trust Jira's remaining estimate.

entry.name: jiraShowHuTab
entry.label: Show the "HU" tab (user stories / parents of the fetched sub-tasks)

entry.name: jiraShowHechasTab
entry.label: Show the "Hechas" tab (my finished sub-tasks)

entry.name: jiraDebug
entry.label: Log Jira fetch / parse / filter details to plasmashell stdout

entry.name: jira2Site
entry.label: Jira 2 Cloud site, e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net

entry.name: jira2Email
entry.label: Jira 2 account email

entry.name: jira2Token
entry.label: Jira 2 API token

entry.name: jira2Jql
entry.label: JQL query for Jira 2
entry.default: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC

entry.name: jira2RefreshMinutes
entry.label: Jira 2 auto-refresh interval in minutes (0 = manual only)

entry.name: jira2MaxResults
entry.label: Jira 2 maximum number of issues to fetch per call

entry.name: jira2CategoryCount
entry.label: Number of Jira 2 categories (tabs)

entry.name: jira2CategoryNames
entry.label: Display name of each Jira 2 category (up to 10)

entry.name: jira2CategoryColors
entry.label: Hex color of each Jira 2 category (up to 10)

entry.name: jira2CategoryTextColors
entry.label: "white" or "black" text color for each Jira 2 category swatch (up to 10)

entry.name: jira2CategoryFilterFields
entry.label: Field that each Jira 2 category filters on (up to 10). Default: status.

entry.name: jira2CategoryFilterValues
entry.label: Value to match for each Jira 2 category (use ';' for OR, up to 10)

entry.name: jira2StatusNames
entry.label: Jira 2 status names whose chip color is overridden

entry.name: jira2StatusColors
entry.label: Hex color for each overridden Jira 2 status name

entry.name: jira2SprintField
entry.label: Jira 2 Sprint custom field id (usually customfield_10020)

entry.name: jira2RemainingMode
entry.label: Jira 2 sprint "Disponible" hours: "calculated" = max(0, original - spent); "api" = Jira's remaining estimate.

entry.name: jira2ShowHuTab
entry.label: Show the Jira 2 "HU" tab (user stories / parents)

entry.name: jira2ShowHechasTab
entry.label: Show the Jira 2 "Hechas" tab (my finished sub-tasks)

entry.name: jira2Debug
entry.label: Log Jira 2 fetch / parse / filter details to plasmashell stdout

entry.name: ghToken
entry.label: GitHub Personal Access Token (classic with 'project,read:org,repo' or fine-grained with Projects read access). Stored in plain text under ~/.config.

entry.name: ghOwner
entry.label: GitHub login of the project owner (user or organization)

entry.name: ghOwnerType
entry.label: "user" or "organization"

entry.name: ghProjectNumber
entry.label: Project (V2) number, as shown in the URL .../projects/<N>

entry.name: ghStatusField
entry.label: Name of the single-select field used as Status (defaults to "Status")

entry.name: ghIncludeClosed
entry.label: Include closed issues / merged PRs in the fetch

entry.name: ghRefreshMinutes
entry.label: Auto-refresh interval in minutes (0 = manual only)

entry.name: ghMaxResults
entry.label: Maximum number of project items to fetch per call

entry.name: ghDebug
entry.label: Log GitHub fetch / parse / filter details to plasmashell stdout

entry.name: ghCategoryCount
entry.label: Number of GitHub Projects categories (tabs)

entry.name: ghCategoryNames
entry.label: Display name of each GitHub Projects category

entry.name: ghCategoryColors
entry.label: Hex color of each GitHub Projects category

entry.name: ghCategoryTextColors
entry.label: "white" or "black" text color for each GitHub category swatch

entry.name: ghCategoryFilterFields
entry.label: Field that each GitHub category filters on

entry.name: ghCategoryFilterValues
entry.label: Value to match for each GitHub category (use ';' for OR)

entry.name: notionQuery
entry.label: Free-text query for /v1/search (empty = all pages)

entry.name: notionFilter
entry.label: "page" or "database" (filters /v1/search by object type)

entry.name: notionMaxResults
entry.label: Maximum number of Notion pages to fetch per call

entry.name: notionRefreshMinutes
entry.label: Auto-refresh interval in minutes (0 = manual only)

entry.name: notionCliPath
entry.label: Path to the ntn binary (empty = let $PATH resolve it)

entry.name: notionDebug
entry.label: Log Notion fetch / parse details to plasmashell stdout

entry.name: notionApiToken
entry.label: Notion internal integration token (secret_… / ntn_…). Stored in plain text under ~/.config.

entry.name: notionParentPageId
entry.label: ID of the Notion page under which the ToDo database is created (first-time setup).

entry.name: notionDatabaseId
entry.label: ID of the Notion database the ToDo tasks sync into (set automatically after creation).

entry.name: notionSyncOnOpen
entry.label: Sync the ToDo list with Notion every time the plasmoid opens.
